WITH
modifications AS (
    SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section
    UNION
    SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by
),
memberships AS (
    SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack
    UNION
    SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member
),
documents AS (
    SELECT id, number, replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(trim(target_release)), 'release', ''), 'rel', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '') AS release_key
    FROM document
),
sections AS (
    SELECT id, spec, clause, replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(trim(release)), 'release', ''), 'rel', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '') AS release_key
    FROM section
),
verified_dispositions AS (
    SELECT di.target AS document_id, di.code AS disposition, m.label AS wg_meeting
    FROM disposition AS di
    JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = di.resolution_id
    JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id
    WHERE replace(replace(lower(trim(di.evidence_status)), '-', '_'), ' ', '_') = 'source_verified'
      AND replace(replace(lower(trim(di.scope)), '-', '_'), ' ', '_') IN ('document', 'whole_document')
      AND replace(upper(trim(m.wg)), ' ', '') = 'RAN2'
),
changes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.id AS document_id, d.number AS document,
           s.spec AS specification, s.clause AS clause, d.release_key AS release_key
    FROM documents AS d
    JOIN modifications AS mo ON mo.cr = d.id
    JOIN sections AS s ON s.id = mo.section_id AND s.release_key = d.release_key
),
packed_changes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.document_id, c.document, c.specification, c.clause, c.release_key,
           p.pack_number AS cr_pack, p.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting, p.tsg_number AS tsg_number
    FROM changes AS c
    JOIN memberships AS pm ON pm.cr = c.document_id
    JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = pm.pack_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.clause AS "clause", c.document AS "document",
       vd.disposition AS "disposition", vd.wg_meeting AS "wg_meeting",
       c.cr_pack AS "cr_pack"
FROM changes AS anchor
JOIN packed_changes AS c
  ON c.specification = anchor.specification
 AND c.clause = anchor.clause
 AND c.release_key = anchor.release_key
 AND c.document <> anchor.document
JOIN verified_dispositions AS vd ON vd.document_id = c.document_id
WHERE anchor.document = 'R2-2102518'
  AND anchor.release_key IN ('16');
